project_name: Facilities for the Army's Heavy Brigade (FHTB) - Vordingborg Barracks - Building 171
project_description: Main construction contract for facilities at Vordingborg Barracks in Denmark. The project includes Building 171 of approximately 3,625 m2 with a garage for 18 spaces, three floors with classrooms, personnel facilities, storage and technical rooms, plus a military obstacle course, perimeter fence expansion, rainwater basin and parking area.
qualification_requirements: Confidentiality declaration required before classified tender material is released
winner: LM Byg og KT Erhvervsbyg Konsortiet

project_description: Parquet flooring works for the new fire station and associated residential building in Bad Soden am Taunus, Germany.
